response.query: Which selection-robust estimators and specific predictors will be pre-specified for attrition adjustment (IPW, pattern-mixture, Lee bounds), and how will we present robustness contours to stakeholders?
response.answer: For attrition adjustment, inverse probability weighting (IPW), pattern-mixture models, and Lee bounds will be used. Robustness contours will be presented visually to stakeholders.
